faq.a: Yes — creating your store and account is free, and you get a full 14-day trial with no card. The plan is only for the extra features.

faq.q: What's the difference between the three plans?
faq.a: Basic to start (up to 30 products), Pro for active shops (POS, sales and profit reports, the customer book, offers, and we build the store with you), and Business for chains & branches (inventory, kitchen, suppliers, accounting, automation, campaigns, attendance & payroll). Your store page, orders and bookings are on every plan — Pro and Business add the management screens behind them.

faq.q: Do I need Pro to take bookings?
faq.a: No. Appointments, table reservations, classes and court slots work on every plan, including a store that never subscribed. Pro adds the team page and the reports on top of them.

faq.q: Does paying make my store verified?
faq.a: No. Every store is reviewed before it goes live, on any plan. The verified badge is a separate, stricter check of a business's documents — no plan buys it, and it has not been awarded to anyone yet.

faq.q: How long does the annual offer last?
faq.a: The annual promo prices ($75 / $150 / $300) run for a limited time — the countdown above shows how long is left. After that, annual reverts to the standard yearly price.

faq.q: Is there a commission on sales?
faq.a: Never — Matjar takes 0% commission on your orders, on any plan. Only the plan subscription.

faq.q: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faq.a: Of course — upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime, and your store and products stay.
Payment is manual for now — request the plan from your store dashboard and we'll contact you to activate it. Online payment is coming soon.

faq.title: Help & FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Matjar.

items.q: How do I order a product?
items.a: Open a store or product, add it to the cart, tap "Order", fill in your address and phone, and confirm. The order reaches the merchant instantly and you can track it under "My orders". Payment is cash on delivery.

items.q: How do I open my store?
items.a: Tap "Open your store", pick your business type, fill in your store name and details, and add products. Your store is ready in minutes with a short link and QR code to share.

Zero commission on sales, on every plan — the customer, their number, and the profit are all yours. Paid plans buy management screens (point of sale, reports, inventory and the rest); the pricing page lists what each one adds and what it costs.

items.q: Is the store I'm buying from checked?
items.a: Every store is reviewed by us before it appears on Matjar, whatever plan it is on. The "verified" badge is a separate, stricter check of a business's documents — it has not been awarded to anyone yet, so no store on Matjar carries it today.
A classifieds section where any user can post listings — buy and sell easily. You can save a search and get notified the moment a matching listing appears.
From your account page tap "Enable notifications" and allow your browser. You'll get order updates, the daily deal, and saved-search matches — even when the site is closed.
Currently cash on delivery, with the option to contact and order directly via WhatsApp with the merchant.

Yes — browsing and buying are completely free. Opening a store is free too: without a subscription you can list 3 products and still take orders and bookings, with no commission on your sales. A paid plan raises the product limit and adds the management screens.
